title: The bar/rod was uneven upon arrival.
text:
The bar/rod was uneven upon arrival.. I used this for my kitchen window. It was not so easy to install. It was difficult to get the screws into the wall and have the curtain become leveled.
After leveling the screws. I noticed the bar or rod that holds the curtain was not even. When I would roll it on the floor. The rod was not evenly made. Contacted customer service but did not get much help.
